sources.title: Verification of Space Weather Forecasts issued by the Met Office Space Weather Operations Centre
sources.summary: The Met Office Space Weather Operations Centre was founded in 2014 and part of its remit is a daily Space Weather Technical Forecast to help the UK build resilience to space weather impacts; guidance includes four day geo-magnetic storm forecasts (GMSF) and X-ray flare forecasts (XRFF). It is crucial for forecasters, users, modelers and stakeholders to understand the strengths and weaknesses of these forecasts; therefore, it is important to verify against the most reliable truth data source available. sources.title: The importance of ensemble techniques for operational space weather forecasting
sources.summary: The space weather community has begun to use frontier methods such as data assimilation, machine learning, and ensemble modeling to advance current operational forecasting efforts. This was highlighted by a multi-disciplinary session at the 2017 American Geophysical Union Meeting, 'Frontier Solar-Terrestrial Science Enabled by the Combination of Data-Driven Techniques and Physics-Based Understanding', with considerable discussion surrounding ensemble techniques. sources.title: Flare forecasting at the Met Office Space Weather Operations Centre
sources.summary: The Met Office Space Weather Operations Centre produces 24/7/365 space weather guidance, alerts, and forecasts to a wide range of government and commercial end users across the United Kingdom. Solar flare forecasts are one of its products, which are issued multiple times a day in two forms; forecasts for each active region on the solar disk over the next 24 hours, and full-disk forecasts for the next four days. sources.title: Physical AI: Bridging the Sim-to-Real Divide Toward Embodied, Ethical, and Autonomous Intelligence
sources.summary: Physical Artificial Intelligence (Physical AI) delineates a new scientific frontier wherein cognition is not abstracted from the world but materially instantiated within it. It represents the fusion of algorithmic reasoning, embodied perception, and dynamic control into cyber–physical substrates capable of autonomous, safe, and ethically aligned interaction.
